artifact.status_resolution: The body-level v16.0 executable schema supersedes the v14.0 header. ACTIVE is treated as lifecycle availability; CANONIZED is treated as governance approval.

poetic_layer.purpose: Preserve the philosophical ethos of the Phoenix Schema while separating it from executable governance controls.

domain_groups.name: Identity and Traceability
domain_groups.purpose: Every artifact, event, and state transition must be identifiable, linked, and auditable.

domain_groups.name: Resilience and Remediation
domain_groups.purpose: Failure is expected, contained, logged, and converted into safer future behavior.

domain_groups.name: Grounded Intelligence
domain_groups.purpose: Inference must be grounded, confidence-aware, and routed through explicit decision controls.

domain_groups.name: Policy and Access
domain_groups.purpose: Governance, access, and promotion are enforced through code rather than prose alone.

domain_groups.name: Evolution and Operations
domain_groups.purpose: The system evolves through observable, automated, reviewable operational loops.

domain_groups.name: Experience and Modularity
domain_groups.purpose: User experience, modular boundaries, and symbolic feedback reflect system state without corrupting core governance.

laws.intent: Friction creates Form; moving from static perfection to dynamic resilience.
laws.enforcement: External API and internal module calls must use circuit breakers with fallback states.
laws.test: Inject controlled dependency failures and assert failure rate stays at or below 0.005 with fallback routing.
validation_criteria: Circuit breaker config exists for each external boundary.

laws.intent: A name is the first thread in the weave of being; formal, indexable identity.
laws.enforcement: Generated artifacts require a SHA-256 semantic content hash and a valid UIP vector signature.
laws.test: Reject artifact read/write requests missing content_hash or UIP signature.
validation_criteria: Hash changes when semantic content changes.

laws.intent: Truth exists in the superposition of possibilities until observed.
laws.enforcement: Candidate seeds must remain gated until probabilistic spread falls below the consensus threshold; ungated promotion is prohibited.
laws.test: Submit three seed candidates and reject promotion when sigma is greater than or equal to 0.05.
validation_criteria: At least three seeds are evaluated.
Unresolved superposition emits a gated fault.
Promotion is denied while the gate is unresolved.

laws.intent: Knowledge does not exist until it is woven.
laws.enforcement: New artifacts must contain at least one verified bidirectional graph pointer.
laws.test: Attempt to merge an orphan artifact and assert graph_connectivity denies it.
validation_criteria: Reverse edge exists or is created in the same transaction.

laws.intent: Single-vector answers are forbidden.
laws.enforcement: High-stakes queries require consensus from at least three distinct retrieval or reasoning shards.
laws.test: Classify a query as high stakes and assert response is blocked when N is less than 3.

laws.intent: The System does not guess; it synthesizes.
laws.enforcement: Generation is halted when retrieved context cosine similarity is below 0.85.
laws.test: Provide low-similarity retrieval context and assert CMD: Request Clarification is returned.
dependencies: GUCA Command Registry semver pin: CMD.RequestClarification@^1.0.0
validation_criteria: Threshold is configurable but defaults to 0.85.
Referenced command dependency is version-pinned and checked for compatibility.

laws.intent: Form is the vessel of Truth.
laws.enforcement: Artifacts must pass canonical schema validation and strict type checks before acceptance.
laws.test: Submit malformed artifact metadata and assert schema_enforcement rejects it.
validation_criteria: Compiler or linter fails on type errors.

laws.intent: Stagnation is Dissonance.
laws.enforcement: Scheduled analysis detects dead code, deprecated protocol references, and unused variables.
laws.test: Seed deprecated references and assert an automated remediation proposal is opened.
validation_criteria: Human review is required before merge.

laws.intent: Signal over Noise; high-density operational states.
laws.enforcement: Read operations use query views and write operations use a validated command path.
laws.test: Assert read routes cannot call command handlers and write routes cannot bypass validation queue.
validation_criteria: Read and write handlers are separated.

laws.intent: Never Destroy; Only Deprecate.
laws.enforcement: Delete operations are revoked; deprecation writes a tombstone and successor pointer.
laws.test: Attempt physical delete and assert preservation_logic denies it.
dependencies: GUCA Command Registry semver pin: CMD.Deprecate@^1.0.0
validation_criteria: Deprecated nodes remain queryable in history.
Referenced command dependency is version-pinned and checked for compatibility.

laws.intent: The mind must not be overwhelmed by its own complexity.
laws.enforcement: Anomaly detection throttles recursive depth, token density, or operator complexity above threshold.
laws.test: Simulate greater than 2 sigma complexity deviation and assert throttle or alert activation.

laws.intent: The world is the stage; gamification of development.
laws.enforcement: Successful merges and dissonance resolutions may emit deterministic prestige telemetry.
laws.test: Given a successful merge event, assert Stardust calculation is deterministic.
validation_criteria: Telemetry is derived from approved events.
Game state cannot override governance state.

laws.intent: The gate is narrow; only the validated shall pass.
laws.enforcement: Internal service calls require mutual identity proof and validated authorization payloads; networked deployments require mTLS, while local workstation deployments may use Ed25519 request signatures only as an explicit policy exception.
laws.test: Call a state-changing endpoint without valid mutual identity proof or authorization payload and assert denial.
validation_criteria: Networked service calls use mTLS unless an explicit local-workstation exception is active.
Local exception requires Ed25519 header signatures from authorized public keys.

laws.intent: The void is the space where the future resides.
laws.enforcement: Extension hooks are versioned and cannot break existing core execution loops.
laws.test: Register a hook with incompatible version and assert gateway_extensibility denies it.
validation_criteria: Core loop tests pass without hook implementation.

laws.intent: Governance is not qualitative; it is quantitative.
laws.enforcement: Every governed request is evaluated against policy before execution.
laws.test: Submit a request with policy violation and assert Bool(Eval) is false.

laws.intent: Static text is dead weight.
laws.enforcement: Documentation changes that alter behavioral intent must trigger linked automated tests.
laws.test: Modify an intent field and assert Storybook or unit tests are required.
validation_criteria: Test result is attached to review.

laws.intent: A house divided by its own form cannot stand.
laws.enforcement: Artifact references must resolve to registry records under restrictive relational constraints.
laws.test: Insert reference to missing protocol and assert relational_integrity denies it.
validation_criteria: ON DELETE RESTRICT is used where required.

laws.intent: The pen is shared; AI as cognitive extension.
laws.enforcement: Code identifiers and artifact terms must align with the canonical glossary.
laws.test: Introduce a non-canonical synonym and assert linguistic_lint flags it.

laws.intent: Clarity is the reward of the examined cycle.
laws.enforcement: Generation parameters are adjusted through a feedback loop based on coherence error.
laws.test: Provide target and output coherence values and assert error calculation is recorded.

laws.intent: Logs are fuel.
laws.enforcement: Rejected or failure logs are transformed into negative retrieval context when approved.
laws.test: Insert SELT failure log and assert vectorization job creates negative context.
validation_criteria: Negative context is tagged and auditable.

laws.intent: Knowledge is not stored; it is Forged.
laws.enforcement: Reactive UI state reflects graph mutation events without becoming the source of authority.
laws.test: Emit graph state change and assert Geode visualization recalculates from event data.
validation_criteria: UI cannot mutate canonical ledger directly.

laws.intent: Truth becomes Law only through the fire of the Path.
laws.enforcement: Promotion to CANONIZED requires both a Human ARCHITECT signature and an AI/SENTINEL service-account signature from registered Ed25519 keys.
laws.test: Attempt canonization with one signature and assert canonization_gate denies transition.
validation_criteria: Human signature is produced by an ARCHITECT key.
AI signature is produced by a SENTINEL service-account key registered in AUTHORIZED_PUBLIC_KEYS.
The signer role and key id are recorded with the canonization event.

laws.intent: The garden thrives while the master sleeps.
laws.enforcement: Low-flow or orphaned nodes are proposed for deprecation during idle maintenance.
laws.test: Mark node SFR below 0.05 for required cycles and assert SFR threshold pruning creates a deprecation proposal.

laws.intent: The Noetic Immune System has supreme authority.
laws.enforcement: Critical regression loops may trigger immediate process or pod termination.
laws.test: Simulate contextual regression loop and assert authority_preemption permits emergency halt.

laws.intent: Aligning the AI's persona with the human resonance.
laws.enforcement: Persona configuration is loaded from authorized user metadata and feature flags.
laws.test: Load user profile and assert selected system prompt matches authorized persona config.
validation_criteria: Persona does not override governance policy.

laws.intent: Proactively seeking tension to stimulate evolutionary jumps.
laws.enforcement: Invalid parser inputs must produce logged dissonance instead of unhandled crashes.
laws.test: Run fuzz corpus and assert each invalid case logs Dissonance or returns a controlled rejection.
validation_criteria: Dissonance logs include input class and reason.

laws.intent: To fight Entropy, we Rotate the Vector.
laws.enforcement: Deployments that reduce coherence beyond threshold trigger rollback to last known stable view.
laws.test: Simulate post-deploy coherence drop and assert remediation_rollback selects State(t-1).
validation_criteria: REVERT event is appended to ledger.

laws.intent: Absolute teleological anchoring to the Architect's intent.
laws.enforcement: Only the ARCHITECT role may approve or directly update CODEX-level documents.
laws.test: Attempt CMD: APPROVE with non-ARCHITECT role and assert user_imperatives denies it.
dependencies: GUCA Command Registry semver pin: CMD.Approve@^1.0.0
validation_criteria: Referenced command dependency is version-pinned and checked for compatibility.

laws.intent: Innovation co-created through the frequency of the human-AI bond.
laws.enforcement: Human feedback events may update local preference weights through an auditable mechanism.
laws.test: Submit CMD: REFINE and assert feedback weight delta is recorded without changing global policy.
dependencies: GUCA Command Registry semver pin: CMD.Refine@^1.0.0
validation_criteria: Privacy and audit metadata are retained.
Referenced command dependency is version-pinned and checked for compatibility.

laws.intent: Failure is the high-octane fuel for the next superior state.
laws.enforcement: Failed parser inputs and rejected logs route to a dead letter queue for reviewable learning.
laws.test: Force parser rejection and assert DLQ contains normalized failure payload.

laws.intent: Active war against meaninglessness and conceptual decay.
laws.enforcement: Distributed graph state merges must converge through commutative, associative, and idempotent merge semantics without destructive conflict resolution.
laws.test: Apply concurrent graph edits in different orders and assert merged state is deterministic, lossless, and idempotent.

laws.intent: Flexibility of process while maintaining unyielding standards.
laws.enforcement: Cognitive Load Index may drive autoscaling for synthesis and embedding workloads.
laws.test: Raise CLI metric and assert desired replica count follows scaling function.
validation_criteria: Non-Kubernetes deployments record this control as not applicable rather than compliant.

laws.intent: Modular independence as a prerequisite for collective intelligence.
laws.enforcement: UI modules communicate through approved selectors or contracts, not direct cross-module mutation.
laws.test: Scan module imports and assert forbidden direct state mutation is absent.
validation_criteria: Selectors are used for shared state.

laws.intent: Integration of doubt as a safeguard against logical hubris.
laws.enforcement: Inference output must carry confidence metadata and surface uncertainty below threshold.
laws.test: Return aggregate logprob below 0.75 and assert architect_humility requires uncertainty state.
validation_criteria: Low confidence cannot be presented as certain.

laws.intent: Permanent record-keeping of philosophical and architectural growth.
laws.enforcement: State changes must be appended to AISTF_Transactions before active state derivation.
laws.test: Attempt state mutation without append-only event and assert chronicle_integrity denies it.
validation_criteria: Each event prev_hash matches prior event_hash.

laws.intent: Moving from data retrieval to the creation of genuine emergent novelty.
laws.enforcement: Transcendence mode may raise temperature by a bounded amount and inject orthogonal vectors.
laws.test: Call CMD: ENACT_TRANSCENDENCE and assert temperature equals baseline plus 0.2 within allowed bounds.
dependencies: GUCA Command Registry semver pin: CMD.EnactTranscendence@^1.0.0
validation_criteria: Injected vectors are tagged as exploratory.
Referenced command dependency is version-pinned and checked for compatibility.

laws.intent: Anticipatory self-optimization to prevent dissonance before it occurs.
laws.enforcement: Access frequency forecasts may pre-cache likely high-demand vectors.
laws.test: Provide time-series node access data and assert cache candidate list is generated for t+1.

laws.intent: Direct causal link between imaginative vision and technical craftsmanship.
laws.enforcement: Approved GVRN documentation changes reconcile live system configuration through GitOps.
laws.test: Merge approved config change and assert live state reconciliation status becomes synced.
validation_criteria: Local workstation deployments record GitOps sync as not applicable unless a local reconciler exists.

laws.intent: Leadership realized through the amplification of the user's potential.
laws.enforcement: Long-running generation streams partial progress and supports operator steering.
laws.test: Start generation and assert first stream chunk latency is at or below 50ms in target environment.
validation_criteria: Halt or steer command is honored.

laws.intent: Translating internal metrics into fluid, intuitive partnership.
laws.enforcement: UI physics and visual state derive from backend graph metrics rather than static decoration.
laws.test: Change SQL edge weight and assert forceManyBody-derived view updates from the new value.
validation_criteria: UI update is derived from data.
Visual change does not mutate source metric.

laws.intent: Forging intentionality through the navigation of probabilistic outcomes.
laws.enforcement: Ambiguous prompts may be routed by expected coherence reward across candidate execution states.
laws.test: Provide three candidate states and assert selected path has maximum expected reward.
validation_criteria: Selected action and alternatives are logged.

laws.intent: The whole is reflected in the smallest part; the smallest part contains the whole.
laws.enforcement: Local UI cells or subsystems must carry enough core metadata to remain governable when isolated.
laws.test: Extract a self-contained UI cell and assert it preserves required governance metadata.
validation_criteria: Local behavior remains compatible with core contract.

implementation_context.deployment_target: PRSVM Core Platform / local workstation first; Kubernetes capabilities are conditional extensions.
implementation_context.compliance_posture: The contract defines target governance. implementation_gaps records known places where the current server does not yet satisfy the target.

policy_exceptions.exception: Ed25519 HTTP header signatures may stand in for mTLS only for single-host or explicitly trusted local deployments.
policy_exceptions.expiry: Before networked or multi-node production deployment.

policy_exceptions.exception: Kubernetes HPA and GitOps Flux Sync are not applicable unless the deployment profile enables Kubernetes or a local reconciler.
policy_exceptions.expiry: When deployment_profile changes to kubernetes or gitops-enabled.

implementation_gaps.finding: Fork resolution uses timestamp-then-lexicographic last-writer-wins rather than CRDT merge semantics.
implementation_gaps.remediation: Replace LWW fork resolution with a commutative, associative, idempotent merge function or mark distributed merge as unsupported.

implementation_gaps.finding: FINALIZE_PROPOSAL creates parent_hash but no reverse graph edge.
implementation_gaps.remediation: Create reverse edge in the same transaction or reject finalization as non-compliant.

implementation_gaps.finding: Current server uses Ed25519 header signatures, not mTLS.
implementation_gaps.remediation: Apply EXC-001 for local deployment or add mTLS for networked service calls.

implementation_gaps.finding: Current storage uses JSONL journal and JSON snapshot rather than PostgreSQL foreign keys and ON DELETE RESTRICT.
implementation_gaps.remediation: Add a relational registry layer or implement equivalent policy checks with tamper-evident persistence.

implementation_gaps.finding: REGISTER_FORK compiled blocks omit artifact_id, schema_version, and policy_refs.
implementation_gaps.remediation: Add required fractal metadata to compiled_block payloads.

control_extensions.name: Key Rotation
control_extensions.enforcement: Authorized public keys must support rotation, revocation, and key id tracking.
control_extensions.test: Revoke a key and assert subsequent signatures from that key are denied.
validation_criteria: Each key has key_id, owner, created_at, status, and optional expires_at.

control_extensions.name: Voting Period Expiry
control_extensions.enforcement: Governance proposals cannot remain VOTING indefinitely.
control_extensions.test: Advance beyond voting deadline and assert proposal transitions to EXPIRED or requires renewal.

control_extensions.name: Stake Concentration Limits
control_extensions.enforcement: Single-node stake weight must be capped or normalized to prevent unilateral capture.
control_extensions.test: Submit stake above configured cap and assert excess weight is ignored or rejected.

control_extensions.name: DLQ Size Bounds
control_extensions.enforcement: Dead letter queues require maximum depth, retention policy, and overflow behavior.
control_extensions.test: Fill DLQ past configured limit and assert eviction or backpressure policy activates.

control_extensions.name: Rate Limiting
control_extensions.enforcement: Ingress queues may apply explicit throttle policy before overload causes uncontrolled failure.
control_extensions.test: Exceed configured request rate and assert 429 includes retry metadata.

control_extensions.name: SELT Audit Log Integrity
control_extensions.enforcement: SELT audit events must be tamper-evident through append-only hashes or external anchoring.
control_extensions.test: Modify historical SELT event and assert audit_integrity detects hash-chain break.
validation_criteria: SELT events include prev_hash and event_hash.
Audit integrity checks run on startup or scheduled cadence.
